title: Mike McConnell as Dan Burisch's godfather
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Mike McConnell as Dan Burisch's godfather, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's some weird stories around Dan Barish where I think his like godfather was Mike McConnell

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions in passing that there are strange stories around a man named Dan Burisch. Michels says he thinks that Burisch's godfather was a man named Mike McConnell, and he links the story to another person, Brian Jackson. He brings it up as one more odd personal tie in the web of people around secret UFO programmes.
